phases.title: Keep the fleet in sync
phases.goal: Every project runs the same, current method.
phases.deliverable: No drift between this source of record and any project's installed copies.

phases.title: Grow the method
phases.goal: Capture what's actually practiced but not yet written down.
phases.deliverable: Conventions and skills that match how work really happens.

tasks.title: Install the skill suite into medtech-intel-QMSR once it has code
tasks.note: New venture repo created 2026-07-28, still empty pending the app import. Run ./install.sh --repo <clone> and add it to the fleet table in README.md.

tasks.title: Drift check: installed .claude/skills/ copies vs this repo's source
tasks.note: Two copies of a skill always drift eventually — that risk is why this repo exists. Diff each project's installed copies against skills/, report differences, and open a PR re-installing where they've diverged.

tasks.title: Audit: conventions practiced but not written down
tasks.note: Several rules were learned in conversation and only partly recorded (e.g. file-first deliverable delivery, plan-file union merges, regenerate-don't-hand-merge). Sweep recent project history for rules being followed that conventions/ doesn't state, and propose additions.

tasks.title: Evaluate which built-in Claude skills are worth adopting into the house suite
tasks.note: Candidates seen in use: /security-review before a traffic push, skill-creator for authoring/evaluating skills properly, fewer-permission-prompts to cut interruptions. Owner call on which become house practice.
